During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''unidentified [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]''' was being held as a prisoner in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] in the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He wore an [[Color/Legends|orange]] colored prison jumpsuit.

==Biography==
This Trandoshan was located in the detention facility's mess hall along with a fellow [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]] prisoner when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], disguised as the bounty hunter [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], entered the room.
Later on, when a prison riot ensued, the Trandoshan escaped from the mess hall and fled down a corridor alongsde with a Lutrillian and a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]. However, he was felled by a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blast from a [[Shock trooper/Legends|Clone trooper guard]].
